_about: Everyday fact-pattern questions for retrieval (backend/scripts/eval_scenario_retrieval.py). Written by Claude (AI, not a lawyer) on 2026-10-13. 'expected' lists IPC sections any of which counts as a hit in the retrieved sources. 'dev' questions were used while designing the scenario-retrieval fix; 'test' questions were held out and scored only once, at the end. 'oos' questions are civil / non-IPC narratives that must be refused (with the short out-of-scope questions of scripts/calibrate_retrieval.py).
